calculation_handling.description: A short-term rental is permitted if no more than three bed-sitting rooms in a dwelling unit are used for it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Bed-sitting rooms are not a model target (bedrooms is a different count).

units.disclosure: The three bed-sitting room limit on short-term rentals in a dwelling unit is not evaluated; short-term rental use is outside the modelled building types.

calculation_handling.description: A short-term rental is permitted if the secondary suite is exclusively and separately occupied as a principal residence.
calculation_handling.gaps: Occupancy as a principal residence is not a lot or scenario input.

units.disclosure: The principal-residence occupancy condition for short-term rental of a secondary suite is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A short-term rental may not be in a vehicle.

units.disclosure: The rule that a short-term rental may not be in a vehicle is not evaluated.

150.13.20.1(1).explanation: A short-term rental is allowed in a dwelling unit, secondary suite or bed-sitting room only if no more than three bed-sitting rooms in a dwelling unit are used for it, a secondary suite used for it is exclusively and separately occupied as a principal residence, and it is not in a vehicle.
